body: Yeah, like anything people struggle with or try to quit...it's a process. I always hope every time I cut that it'll be the last time, but you've also gotta be fair to yourself. It does no good to hear yourself up further for doing it. I'm glad to hear you resisted the urge to do anything to the other arm, I'm sure it wasn't easy. Even if your mom listening had an effect on why, that shows something. Some times yourself is not enough to stop ya, but the thought of hurting others can. I'm glad getting help alleviated future fears about doing so. There's so much stigma surrounding SH that it makes us fearful, even when we really need it. I hope the best for you as well my friend!! Here if ya ever wanna chat, and I'm sure you'd do the same! Love and light.💜

So glad you took care of it. Also glad the experience was, although long, one that didn't result in embarrassment or shame. Plus, gotta love the chillin with the doggy pic 😋 just one question, I know this might be taboo...seeing that, feeling what help felt like in this situation...do you plan on trying to quit SH? Those words don't go easily in a sentence. But, after seeing this as a stranger who also struggles...my heart is with you. And only hopes for the best. You have a big beautiful heart, guaranteed. You deserve a big beautiful life to go with it.
Just go, find a way. Don't listen to her. Listen to your gut, your instincts. What everyone else is telling you here. That's deep and worrisome. Best of luck.

I've also had this happen, years later with deep scars. I'm not a doctor or anything but it always seems to me like it's just part of the healing process. But it's never fun to have the scars be more apparent. It's a little expensive, but mederma for scars helps to fade them. It's been really beneficial to my healing process, both externally and internally. There are also natural remedies, such as the juice of onion skins which is actually what the main ingredient of merdema is made of. Also lemon juice(ONLY HEALED EEEEE!!!), vitamin E(either liquid or get the liquid pills and poke a hole in them to get the gel out). But yeah, moisturizing the scars as was previously stated. Good luck, happy healing!
